title: 2019 年 12 月英语六级真题（第 3 套）

analysis.topic: 荷花的特征、功能与文化象征
analysis.reference: The lotus flower, one of the most renowned flowers in China, is deeply loved by the Chinese people. Lakes and ponds in many parts of China are suitable for the growth of lotus flowers. With bright and vivid colors, the lotus blooms in the early morning in summer and closes at night. Its blooming period can last as long as two to three months, attracting tourists from all over the country to enjoy its beauty. The lotus flower serves multiple functions: it can green the water surface, beautify courtyards and gardens, and also purify water quality, reduce pollution, and improve the environment. Braving the scorching sun without fear and rising from the mud unstained, the lotus symbolizes purity and elegance. It is often used as a metaphor for a person's noble character and has always been an important subject for poets and painters in their creative works. Places where lotus flowers are in full bloom are also frequently visited by many photography enthusiasts.

sentences.cn: 荷花具有多种功能，既能绿化水面，又能美化庭园，还可净化水质、减少污染、改善环境。
sentences.en: The lotus flower serves multiple functions: it can green the water surface, beautify courtyards and gardens, and also purify water quality, reduce pollution, and improve the environment.
sentences.structure: 总分结构，冒号后用并列谓语展开说明多种功能，体现"既……又……还……"的递进关系
keys: 多种功能 multiple functions
绿化水面 green the water surface
美化庭园 beautify courtyards and gardens
净化水质 purify water quality
减少污染 reduce pollution
改善环境 improve the environment

sentences.cn: 荷花迎骄阳而不惧，出污泥而不染，象征纯洁、高雅，常常用来比喻人的高尚品德，历来是诗人画家创作的重要题材。
sentences.en: Braving the scorching sun without fear and rising from the mud unstained, the lotus symbolizes purity and elegance. It is often used as a metaphor for a person's noble character and has always been an important subject for poets and painters in their creative works.
sentences.structure: 现在分词短语（Braving...and rising...）作方式状语前置，主句含并列谓语（symbolizes / is used / has been），长句拆分为两句以增强可读性
keys: 迎骄阳而不惧 braving the scorching sun without fear
出污泥而不染 rising from the mud unstained
象征纯洁、高雅 symbolize purity and elegance
比喻人的高尚品德 a metaphor for a person's noble character
诗人画家创作的重要题材 an important subject for poets and painters

sentences.cn: 荷花盛开的地方也是许多摄影爱好者经常光顾之地。
sentences.en: Places where lotus flowers are in full bloom are also frequently visited by many photography enthusiasts.
sentences.structure: where 引导定语从句修饰 places，主句用被动语态表达"光顾"
keys: 盛开 be in full bloom
摄影爱好者 photography enthusiasts
光顾 frequently visit

pitfalls: '出污泥而不染'是文化意象，需译出'泥'和'不沾染'的双重含义，不可直译为 not dirty
'花期'误译为 flower period，应使用 blooming period 或 flowering period
'绿化水面'中 green 作动词使用，许多考生不知 green 可作动词
'既……又……还……'递进关系需用并列结构或分号体现层次，不可逐个写成独立句
'历来'表示'从古至今一直'，应译为 has always been，注意用现在完成时体现延续性

upgrades.plain: The lotus flower has many colors.
upgrades.better: With bright and vivid colors, the lotus blooms...
upgrades.note: 用 with 短语前置作状语，句式更紧凑、信息层次更丰富

upgrades.plain: It is not afraid of the hot sun and is not made dirty by mud.
upgrades.better: Braving the scorching sun without fear and rising from the mud unstained.
upgrades.note: 分词短语前置更具文学性，unstained 一词精准传递文化内涵

upgrades.plain: which makes tourists come and watch
upgrades.better: attracting tourists from all over the country to enjoy its beauty
upgrades.note: 现在分词作结果状语更简洁地道，enjoy its beauty 比 watch 更优雅

upgrades.plain: Poets and painters always write and paint about the lotus.
upgrades.better: has always been an important subject for poets and painters in their creative works
upgrades.note: 以荷花为主语保持主题一致性，creative works 涵盖诗画两种形式

upgrades.plain: Many photographers often go to places where lotus flowers bloom.
upgrades.better: Places where lotus flowers are in full bloom are also frequently visited by photography enthusiasts.
upgrades.note: 被动语态突出地点主语，in full bloom 比 bloom 更生动饱满
